shorts.title: I Tried to Befriend a Cassowary 🦶 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
Would you get within kicking distance of this bird? 👇

This bird has a four-inch dagger. Cassowaries also spread rainforest seeds: some only sprout after passing through one.

shorts.title: I Tried to Outsmart a Box Jellyfish 👀 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
Would you swim there? 👇

This jellyfish has twenty-four eyes. Box jellyfish sting in Australia? Vinegar on the sting, then call emergency services (000). Vinegar stops unfired stingers; it is not a cure.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: I Poked a Honey Badger 🦡 (Would Meatball Survive?)
shorts.description:
Which animal would you least want to annoy? 👇

This badger is built to resist cobra venom. The same venom-blocking receptor change evolved separately in honey badgers, hedgehogs, pigs and mongooses.
